Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Karan - 35 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Manoj - 38 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama
3. Meenakshi - 57 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Sonali - 30 years, friend
Look: green saree
5. Hema - 28 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The restaurant - round tables, soft light
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it
4. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The restaurant - Day

[Karan stands in the restaurant. Meenakshi and Hema stand near him.]

Karan: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan sits at the table and eats.]

Hema (gently): "What next?"

[Karan raises his glass of wine for a toast.]

Hema: "What next?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Karan stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Sonali stand near him.]

Karan: "Sonali, look over here."

[Karan presses a cloth to the wound to stop the bleeding.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[The doorbell rings; Karan opens the door and takes the parcel.]

Karan: "And then?"

[Karan orders food on his phone.]

Meenakshi: "Karan, are you okay?"

[Karan jumps in his seat at the scary scene.]

Sonali: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Karan stands by the road. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Karan, look over here."

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Karan: "What happened?"

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Karan: "Oh wow!"

[Karan drives the car to the office.]

Karan (excited): "One more time!"

[Karan gets out of the car.]

Karan: "What next?"

Scene 4: The office - Day

[Karan stands in the office. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Karan: "What a nice place."

[Karan sits down at his desk and starts typing.]

Karan: "I'm ready!"

[Karan answers the phone at his desk.]

Karan (surprised): "Yes, all right."

[Karan stretches after hours at the computer.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, all right."

[Karan presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Meenakshi: "Hmm, I see."

[Karan shakes hands with the new client.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
